vault_line: Tonight in Jozi, I'm in Jozi
bar: Tonight in Jozi, I'm in Jozi
chip_form: Tonight in Jozi, I'm in Jozi (johannesburg informally)
note_excerpt: Johannesburg is informally referred to as Jozi.

vault_line: I been wantin' you so bad (Peru, para)
bar: I been wantin' you so bad (Peru, para)
chip_form: I been wantin' you so bad (Peru, para) (baby im loosing con control)
note_excerpt: In this line, Fireboy DML is paying homage to Peruzzi’s 2019 song with MC Galaxy ohaa remix in which he sings: “Gwara gwara for baby, see I’m loo-oo. Shaku shaku for daddy eh”. In a song with Dj Ecool and Davido, the singer said: “Baby I’m loosing con control” Fireboy is referring to loosing control

vault_line: Mo n korin funwon won jo si
bar: Mo n korin funwon won jo si
chip_form: Mo n korin funwon won jo si (im singing to them)
note_excerpt: In Yoruba this means “I’m singing to them”

chip_form: My third album is loading (the eleventh song on ed)
note_excerpt: This is a reference to the eleventh song on Ed’s fifth album, “Love In Slow Motion”. It also talks about how he was enjoying his life.
